system.description: While mounted on a living beast, you can ride to the local watering hole without needing to make a Check. But during an action scene, your mount might panic, and you might get tossed for 1d6 bludgeoning for every 10ft Move your mount has, plus its size value. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, your mount doesn't stumble, and you stay upright.

upgrades.description: Your mount has +5ft Move. You no longer suffer Disadvantage when attacking while Riding.
Your mount has an additional +10ft Move. When other crawlers in your party roll this Skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).
Your mount has an additional +15ft Move. When performing crazy stunts (like jumping through flames), roll with Advantage.

system.limitations: The rider in control of the mount rolls Attack Skill Checks with Disadvantage.
